from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class AccountsPayableRecord(BaseModel):
    """Accounts payable figure from one company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company from the report")
    accounts_payable_amount: str | None = Field(description="The accounts payable amount as written in the document (to preserve formatting)")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency of the reported amount, if specified")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The period this report covers, e.g., '2024 Q1'")
    statement_label: str | None = Field(description="Exact label used for accounts payable in the document")
    quote: str = Field(description="Short verbatim excerpt showing the accounts payable figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    accounts_payable_records: list[AccountsPayableRecord]
